Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: GLM-5.3 ¥104.40 vs Qwen3.8-Flash ¥10.02 on a common CNY basis (list prices ¥104.40 / ¥10.02) — at this fixed usage, Qwen3.8-Flash is cheaper by ¥94.38/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, GLM-5.3 costs about 10.4× Qwen3.8-Flash (Qwen3.8-Flash is ~90% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices ¥8 vs ¥0.8; after conversion Qwen3.8-Flash is lower (by ≈ ¥7.2/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices ¥28 vs ¥2.7; after conversion Qwen3.8-Flash is lower (by ≈ ¥25.3/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): GLM-5.3 ¥2; Qwen3.8-Flash ¥0.1.
  • Context window: GLM-5.3 1024K vs Qwen3.8-Flash 1000K — GLM-5.3 is 1.0× Qwen3.8-Flash.
  • Modalities: GLM-5.3=Text; Qwen3.8-Flash=Text, Image understanding, Video understanding (Qwen3.8-Flash adds Image understanding, Video understanding).
  • Price sources: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — GLM-5.3 model page (verified 2026-10-28), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — Qwen3.8-Flash model page (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (GLM-5.3 in CNY, Qwen3.8-Flash in CNY).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
